_comment: Upper bounds checked by scripts/perf-check. Measured on the M-series Mac CI runner in profile mode; the 'before' values (main before #216) and 'after' values are in the PR that added this file. Bounds sit between the two with margin for noise. 'recording' (#401) is a new scenario with no 'before': its bounds are the measured values with margin, and 80 level readings that each notified the controller would break them.
